findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution to be set up upon inspection. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer bucket was made and tested at 200 ppm Quat. Ensure a sanitizer solution is prepared during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(A) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed the pizza prep cooler to be soiled with food splash. Discussed with PIC, cooler will be cleaned. Ensure non food contact surfaces are being cleaned at a frequency that prevents food splash accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: Observed creamer machine at an internal temperature of 71 degrees F. Stopped operation of machine, and machine was removed from service. PIC has placed a work order for a new machine and so the facility will not utilize this creamer station until proper cold holding is available. Ensure cold holding units are checked daily for proper temperature. 
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-501.11: Observed the gasket on the bottom of the left door of the pizza prep cooler to be in a state of disrepair. PIC has placed a work order to replace said item. Ensure gaskets remain in good repair to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. 
4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications. (C) Cutting or piercing parts of can opens shall be kept sharp to minimize metal fragmentation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The following areas were observed to have an accumulation of dust/debris: 
-Rack above pizza prep cooler
-Left side of slushee machine, near air intake
Ensure the listed areas are cleaned to remove the current accumulation of dust/debris. Ensure the cleaning continues at a frequency necessary to maintain cleanliness of these areas. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: Light under the right side of hood system observed to have water accumulation in the glass case. PIC has submitted a work order to fix said item. Ensure repairs are made to prevent water accumulation in the glass case. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The following areas were observed to have accumulated dust/debris:
-Light casings in the kitchen
-Wall behind storage rack above triple sink
-Counter under Cappuccino machine. 
Ensure these places are clean to remove the accumulated dust/debris. Ensure to keep areas clean of dust/debris accumulation. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114  (P) Quaternary ammonium sanitizers should be maintained at 200 ppm to 400 ppm per the manufacturer's label. The only sani bucket observed in the facility during the inspection was observed at 0 ppm. The bucket was remade to correct.
